description: PR 37 (docs: v0.2.0 build waves) is ~30 commits and too big to review. Split it into reviewable PRs stacked on trunk. Current line: bookmark v020-build at 85833b4d, base trunk d0cb5227, plus two local unpushed chains (e10s03, e12s02) pending wave-8 integration (see specs/state.yaml handoff and the wave-8 issue). title: README test snippet fails: createdb needs a host-side Postgres client
description: Development section runs 'docker run -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=jjhub postgres:17-alpine' then 'createdb jjhub_test'. The machine has no postgres client (pg_isready/psql not found), and createdb would target a host socket the container never publishes. Fix: add -e POSTGRES_DB=jjhub_test to the run line (or docker exec). Reproduced 2026-10-19 during preflight: cargo test failed with DATABASE_URL must be set until an ephemeral container published 5432.
close_reason: Fixed: README license set to Apache License 2.0, test snippet uses POSTGRES_DB, status line reworded, Preflight test command unified to cargo test --workspace (matches CI), release-plan status ready.
